verdict.rationale: Salesmate's pricing page documents its own workflow automation feature ("smart flow" credits used to automate sales and marketing playbooks), and the homepage mentions automated nurture journeys. The evidence never explicitly describes users defining trigger-on-event rules or condition/action logic. missing for 10: explicit documentation of event triggers (e.g., record created, field changed), user-defined conditions and actions, a rule builder, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: With extra smart flow credits, scale your workflow automations and automate your end-to-end sales and marketing playbooks.
